title: mRNA expression analysis by real-time PCR
protocol: Extract total RNA from at least 2 x 10^6 cells using TRIZOL reagent and the appropriate RNeasy RNA extraction kit.
Reverse-transcribe 60 ng of total RNA with a High-capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription kit in a reaction volume of 200 microliters.

Prepare a reaction mix (25 μl) according to the following recipe: 2X Sybr Green PCR Master Mix - 12.5 microliters, 1 μM primer mix - 2.5 microliters, cDNA (5 ng/microliter) - 2 microliters, water - 8 microliters.
Perform Real-Time PCR on 10 ng of cDNA using a Power Sybr Green PCR Master MIX.

Start the amplification procedure according to the following standard protocol: 50°C for 2 minutes, 95°C for 10 minutes, followed by 40 cycles of 95°C for 15 seconds and 60°C for 1 minute. Include a dissociation step at 95°C for 15 seconds and 60°C.
Perform a dissociation assay to evaluate any problems related to primer unspecific annealing or secondary structure formation.
Analyze data with built-in SDS Analysis Software.
